verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm a working llms.txt at docs.cdp.coinbase.com indexing 516 pages. The x402 docs are served as raw Markdown (.md) pages that point agents back to that llms.txt index, so the docs are agent-consumable. missing for 10: an x402-specific llms.txt (the probed index covers all of CDP, and x402.org was not probed), independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs
